## About

CRIB is a full-stack digital growth partner specializing in custom software development, conversion-driven websites, SEO strategy, and social media acceleration. We build the systems and platforms your next stage of growth demands.

## Why Choose CRIB

### Unified Product & Marketing
Product strategists, engineers, and growth leads work in integrated pods to ensure launches are cohesive from code to campaign.

### Modular Delivery
Sprint-based roadmaps keep software, web, SEO, and social initiatives shipping every two weeks without bottlenecks.

### Data-Backed Decisions
Live dashboards, attribution models, and experimentation frameworks translate insights into actionable next steps.

### Momentum After Launch
Retainers focused on iteration—support, optimization, and enablement ensure your team is never left stranded.
